| [github.com/otfabric/go-ieee20305/agent](agent.md) | Package agent is the behaviour of an IEEE 2030.5 device on top of package client: it finds the server's resources from DeviceCapability, keeps its clock in step with the server's, registers its EndDevice and checks the PIN of its Registration, and then polls its FunctionSetAssignments at the server's pollRate, retrying with backoff when the server fails. |

| [github.com/otfabric/go-ieee20305/csipaus/csipclient](csipaus-csipclient.md) | Package csipclient is what a CSIP-AUS device needs beyond package client (with csipaus.Codec as its codec) and package agent: the ConnectionPoint of its EndDevice. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-ieee20305/csipaus/csipserver](csipaus-csipserver.md) | Package csipserver configures a server of package server for CSIP-AUS: the documents of package csipaus, the ConnectionPoint of each EndDevice, and the site limits (dynamic operating envelopes) of DERControls and DefaultDERControls. |
